summary: LuxExperience B.V. (NYSE: LUXE) filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of the sale of the set of assets powering THE OUTNET platform to The O Group LLC (renamed The Outnet Operations US, LLC). The transaction was previously announced on October 31, 2025, and all conditions, including regulatory approvals, have been fulfilled. No financial terms (price per share, premium, implied value) were disclosed in the filing. The board did not state a recommendation here, as closing has already occurred. This is a completed divestiture; watch for any post-closing adjustments or impact on LuxExperience's transformation.
